purpose: Repository-mediated Phase-1/Phase-2 portfolio control for the actual enabled O Chat-mode parallel/support pool. This file never controls or replaces the authoritative O Work primary executor or protected recovery monitor.
authoritative_for: all currently enabled non-primary O support roles selected through DESIRED_STATE/DOWNSTREAM_STATE/O_OPERATIONS

phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.root_problem: Make the existing currently enabled non-primary pool able, within actual scheduled Chat-mode capabilities, to reconstruct its latest role-relevant state, receive optimizer-directed role/scope/method allocation through note control, perform all Chat-capable work, persist evidence/continuation, avoid conflict/duplication, and hand off only irreducible Work-exclusive or primary-writer actions while the authoritative primary O execution stays unchanged.
phase.acceptance_criterion: Every currently enabled managed role in the active-pool manifest has durable assignment-bound evidence for fresh state reconstruction, current optimizer assignment binding, Chat-capable useful work, evidence/continuation persistence, non-conflict/duplication discipline and precise exclusive-action handoff behavior as applicable. A source-qualified immutable durable role artifact OR role receipt may prove a cell only when it binds the current phase/root/task/control tuple and demonstrates the required behavior. Unsupported or missing cells fail closed.
phase.on_acceptance: Persist completion evidence, preserve all base/restoration continuations, clear Phase-1-specific assignments, immediately compute a full-pool Phase-2 portfolio minimizing expected elapsed time to the unchanged authoritative primary O objective, and enter phase_2_acceleration without a blanket restoration interval.

active_pool.selection_rule: Only roles physically enabled at the observed platform state are counted as executing Phase-1 workers. Repository-configured but physically inactive roles remain preserved in restoration metadata and are not counted as active proof cells. This observation never itself changes scheduler enable/disable state.

coordination.o_human_monitor_assignment: selected-existing read-only user-input state reconstruction behavior; O_OPERATIONS remains unchanged
coordination.phase_1_no_restore_rule: Completed, blocked or low-value Phase-1 leaf => immediately reassign within Phase 1. Base role is fallback/restoration metadata only until root acceptance or inability to continue optimizer control safely.

assignment_identity_authority.clean: DESIRED_STATE.phase1_clean_assignment_overlay assignment task_id is authoritative for current CLEAN assignment identity.
assignment_identity_authority.o_chat_parallel: This file caches exact assignment identities for proof integration but is non-authoritative. Cached ids MUST exactly equal the authoritative source. Any mismatch fails closed for assignment-bound acceptance and automation_optimizer repairs this mirror before further closure.
assignment_identity_authority.human_monitor: O_OPERATIONS unchanged selected read-only behavior; an acceptance proof must explicitly bind the Phase-1 task identity carried here or a future authoritative repository field.

problem_solving_contract.source: J-derived complete problem-solving mechanism; J AGI objective excluded

forecast_nodes: 2 audit leaves: primary-source validity and reproducibility/tool feasibility
2 comparator leaves: dedup/relevance-free candidate comparison and evidence strength
integrator leaf: Phase-1 proof matrix/problem-tree integration
human-monitor leaf: read-only user-request freshness/change detection
3 transversal candidates: common durable proof/assignment schema, common Chat capability boundary matrix, common conflict/handoff verifier
phase_1_plan.direct_attempt: Use existing repository control/readback/durable artifact/receipt mechanisms as the common substrate; do not build a second control plane. Redirect the active pool through additive overlays and prove execution through exact assignment-bound durable evidence.

transversal_candidates.hypothesis: one common assignment-bound durable proof schema can close multiple role-specific acceptance leaves
transversal_candidates.test: accept source-qualified immutable role artifacts or receipts only when they bind exact current phase/root/task/control tuple, preserve base continuation, show substantive progress or exact blocker, and carry exact next Phase-1 action

transversal_candidates.hypothesis: a single actual-Chat capability matrix can prevent repeated false Work/background assumptions across roles
transversal_candidates.test: auditors and open-source/repro roles classify direct Chat-capable vs exclusive/unavailable actions with concrete tool evidence

transversal_candidates.hypothesis: one exact conflict/ownership/handoff schema can remove duplicate-work and unsafe-primary-action branches
transversal_candidates.test: integrator/bridge verify reserved write scope, primary-only action type, exact handoff artifact and no primary state mutation

expected_completion.approach: one or more recurring cycles until all active proof cells have current assignment-bound durable evidence
expected_completion.overrun_trigger: If any active role lacks valid assignment-bound durable evidence after two expected invocations, or produces no substantive Phase-1 progress twice, generate and compare an alternative Phase-1 role/method allocation and reforecast before adding more decomposition.

long_horizon.note: preserved only; scheduler observed inactive; no scheduler mutation performed

downstream.restoration_rule: Restore each role's exact config revision/policy from this immutable blob only when Phase 1 is complete and Phase 2 selects it, or when optimizer control cannot safely continue; never as automatic post-subtask behavior.

o_operations.restoration_rule: O_OPERATIONS remains unchanged by this Phase-1 allocation; protected recovery behavior and human-request semantics remain authoritative.

historical_canary_evidence.rule: Prior A/B/C canary design/evidence remains historical support. It is not current active-pool acceptance unless those roles independently become physically active; no scheduler mutation is implied.

phase_1_acceptance_matrix.proof_binding_rule: A proof surface passes only when it binds the current phase_id, root_problem_id, exact authoritative assignment task_id and frozen control/config tuple, and demonstrates the required behavior. Filename location alone is never sufficient. Artifact-vs-receipt surface is not a quality distinction.
phase_1_acceptance_matrix.closure_rule: All 16 active role cells must pass on current assignment-bound durable evidence. Missing/stale/unbound evidence or unsupported inference is not a pass.

optimizer.phase_1_goal: Minimize expected elapsed time to durable full-pool Chat-parity acceptance using all currently enabled non-primary workers while preserving primary execution and special independence constraints.
optimizer.phase_2_goal: After acceptance, continuously minimize expected elapsed time to the unchanged authoritative primary O objective.
optimizer.next_action: Collect exact current task-bound durable evidence for the remaining unresolved active cells: neuroscience, primary_source_verifier, o_novelty_comparator, evidence_comparator and o_human_request_monitor. Reassign completed/blocked/duplicate leaves within Phase 1; generate alternatives on repeated non-progress; close the root only when all 16 active proof cells pass.
